description: This file defines an interface and a class for wrapping libcurl's multi-handle API, facilitating mock testing and abstraction for network operations.

classes.name: CurlWrapsImpl
classes.description: An abstract class providing virtual methods to perform curl multi operations, intended to be implemented for mocking or custom behavior.

classes.name: CurlWraps
classes.description: A singleton-like class providing static methods to access curl multi functionalities, with an internal implementation pointer.
